standard: Sign-on log: workstation logons and logoffs, and remote sign-ons (single sign-on, webmail, VPN)
cadence: per event; complete for workstation logons and for remote sign-ons
notes: One folder per organisation: city, nascc, brw, port, srmc, bcmc, county. Each organisation has its own products, rule names, zone names and habits; do not assume a value seen in one folder means the same in another. Hosts, addresses and accounts are in registries/partner_it_registry.json.

fields.name: host
fields.notes: workstation, or the remote sign-on service host (registry host_id)

fields.name: event_id
fields.notes: 4624 logon, 4634 logoff, 4625 failed logon on Windows workstations; login, logout, login-failed on macOS workstations; sso-login, webmail-login, vpn-login on the remote services

fields.name: account
fields.notes: registry account; mailbox form for the city single sign-on and the base webmail

fields.name: logon_type
fields.notes: 2 interactive, 7 unlock (console, unlock on macOS workstations), remote

fields.name: src_ip
fields.notes: the workstation itself, or the outside address of a remote sign-on

fields.name: src_network
fields.notes: internal, or the network of the outside address as ASN <number>; the same address carries the same number in every stream

fields.name: device
fields.notes: kind of machine for workstation events; known device / new device for remote sign-ons (whether the service had seen that browser or client before)
